decisions.reason: The single-board decision eliminates the two interboard input connectors, reducing the total from ten to eight, but it does not eliminate the eight sensor-facing connectors; removing sensor_output_connectors is unsupported.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Yes, I think that should be possible. With only one board plus sensors, buttons, and LEDs that are all easy to position, I do not expect an issue wherever you place the connectors.

value_updates.separate_sensor_board_status: not present in the single-board design

decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already removes the obsolete POWER_BOARD context while preserving the switched-5V-rail behavior; no additional or corrected propagation is required.
